row.title: SOCIAL-MODULE-1: one-click Buffer and Mastodon links
row.body: Buffer registers its own OAuth app at its registration endpoint and uses authorization code with PKCE as a public client, so the connect link needs no key from a person. Mastodon uses one link with the instance in it. Never-linked channels appear in the owner-acts list.
